title: Monotonicity of symmetric convex sums
statement:
Let $f\colon\bbr\to\bbr$ be convex on the half-line $[0,\infty)$, and let $x,y$ be real numbers with $0 \le x \le y \le 1$. Then
\[
  f(1+x) + f(1-x) \;\le\; f(1+y) + f(1-y).
\]
replaced:
If $f$ is convex on $[0,\infty)$ and $0 \le x \le y \le 1$, then
\[
  f(1+x) + f(1-x) \;\le\; f(1+y) + f(1-y).
\]
